preconditions.description: The length of the input text is no more than 10000 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz .,!?\n' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: The input text consists only of lowercase Latin letters, spaces, and punctuation marks (dot, comma, exclamation mark, question mark).

preconditions.expression: any(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: The input text contains at least one word.

postconditions.expression: all(c not in ' ' for c in stdout if c in '.,!?')
postconditions.description: There are no spaces before any punctuation marks in the output.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout[i] == ' ' for i in range(len(stdout)) if stdout[i-1] in '.,!?' and stdout[i] != ' ')
postconditions.description: There is exactly one space after each punctuation mark in the output.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout[i] == ' ' for i in range(len(stdout)-1) if stdout[i] in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' and stdout[i+1] in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz')
postconditions.description: Words are separated by exactly one space in the output.
